armbands in Latin

armbands

armillae natātōriae

Working formationComposed phrasesDraft
  • armillae natātōriae — armbands, water wings our formation Our formation, after Morgan–Owens’s pinna natātōria for a flipper; armilla, a bracelet, is classical.
  • Armillās natātōriās indue, deinde in aquam dēscende. — Put your armbands on, then get into the water. composed

See also: life jacket, float.
